tooltips.aiBillingCurrency: Read-only snapshot of the open-ended AI billing rate period. Manage history under the AI Billing Rates panel — each period has Effective From / Effective To so past invoices stay stable when prices change.
tooltips.aiBillingPackUnitPrice: Read-only snapshot from the current open rate period. Edit under AI Billing Rates.
tooltips.aiBillingExtraBasePrice: Read-only snapshot from the current open rate period. Edit under AI Billing Rates.
tooltips.aiBillingExtraUnitPrice: Read-only snapshot from the current open rate period. Edit under AI Billing Rates.
tooltips.aiBillingPackSize: Current read-only value. Maximum number of agent runs per pack. Edit under AI Billing Rates.
tooltips.aiBillingExtraIncludedTurns: Current read-only value. Number of customer message runs included in the base charge per conversation and day. Edit under AI Billing Rates.
tooltips.aiBillingPlanIncludedUsage: Current read-only value. Monthly allowance of packs (pack model) or conversations and opportunities handled (extra model). Edit under AI Billing Rates.
tooltips.aiBillingCreditUnitPrice: Current read-only value. Price per credit in the credit model. Each agent run consumes 1 credit, regardless of the number of LLM calls or tokens. Edit under AI Billing Rates.
tooltips.aiBillingPlanIncludedCredits: Current read-only value. Monthly credit allowance in the credit model. Each agent run consumes 1 credit. Edit under AI Billing Rates.
